items.text: no flash of the open index before the cover: the stage is there from the first moment
the field plays again for anyone with saved bytebeat formulas (the founding pack gives ten). The formula list was drawn before the sound engine existed, which stopped Current from starting

a self-test on load: Current checks the field is playing, and its presets, G-code, index, settings, paths and sound. If something is down, a message says so by itself, with reload and a report to send
the founders count shows once 20 have joined; until then the club invites you to be one of the first 100
cards carry the tagline, Play the field, over a shorter line that ends with an invitation to the founders club
the cards are made ahead: when you open share, they are already there, and they sharpen while you look
the founders club is the first 100, not 500: the first 100 get the founding pack and keep Pro free
the challenge: at 100 founders the Pro pre-release opens to the club; the sign-up and the Founding pack show how many have joined
the founding testers are the Current founders club now, everywhere: the cover, the index, the Beat and Color notes, the founding pack
the cover's sign-up reads Play the field, with Join the Current founders club under it
Batch export's badge says Pro, not artist, like every other Pro feature
